title: Schediel share payload, schema version 1.0
description: Sender-approved snapshot selection (CONTRACTS.md sections 2 and 5). Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in x-semanticRules; every validator (Dart client, backend, web preview) must enforce them and report errors with the codes in x-errorCodes and JSON Pointer paths.
x-semanticRules: S01 Calendar dates are real Gregorian dates written YYYY-MM-DD with a year from 1900 through 2199.
S02 Text values are non-empty and trimmed (no leading or trailing Unicode whitespace). Absent optional values are null. Lengths count Unicode code points, not UTF-16 code units or bytes.
S03 timeZone is a valid IANA time-zone identifier known to the validator's time-zone database. Fixed offsets such as +08:00 are rejected.
S04 TimedSpec: endTime and endDayOffset are both null or both non-null. endDayOffset is 0 or 1. When endDayOffset is 0, endTime is later than startTime.
S05 DateOnlySpec: endDateExclusive is after startDate. A recurring date-only item spans exactly one day. A one-time span is at most 366 days.
S06 Recurrence: weekly has a non-empty set of unique ISO weekdays (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday); daily has an empty weekdays array; untilDateInclusive is null or not before time.startDate.

S07 Exceptions exist only on recurring items. originalOccurrenceKey is a date that is an original occurrence of the rule: on or after time.startDate, on or before untilDateInclusive when present, and on a selected weekday for weekly rules. Keys are unique within an item.
S08 action cancel has replacement null. action override has a replacement whose time kind equals the item's time kind; a replacement never carries recurrence or exceptions.
S09 sourceItemId values are unique across items. The total number of exceptions across all items is at most 500.
S10 sharedFieldPolicy: when a detail field's policy is false, that field is null on every item and every replacement.
S11 The canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization of the payload is at most 524288 bytes.

x-errorCodes.unsupported_version: schemaVersion is not a supported version
x-errorCodes.unknown_field: a key that the contract does not define
x-errorCodes.invalid_type: a value has the wrong JSON type
x-errorCodes.invalid_value: an enum, constant, identifier or integer constraint is violated, or a required pairing is incomplete
x-errorCodes.invalid_text: a text value is empty or untrimmed
x-errorCodes.too_long: a text value exceeds its code-point limit
x-errorCodes.too_many: an array exceeds its item limit
x-errorCodes.invalid_date: a value is not a real calendar date in the allowed range
x-errorCodes.invalid_time: a value is not a valid 24-hour HH:mm clock time
x-errorCodes.invalid_time_zone: a value is not a known IANA time-zone identifier
x-errorCodes.invalid_range: an end, span or until boundary is inconsistent with its start
x-errorCodes.invalid_recurrence: weekday selection does not satisfy the frequency rules
x-errorCodes.invalid_exception: an exception is not valid for its item or rule
x-errorCodes.duplicate: a value that must be unique is repeated
x-errorCodes.policy_violation: a detail excluded by sharedFieldPolicy is present
x-errorCodes.payload_too_large: the serialized payload exceeds the byte limit
